description: PEP 751 `pylock.toml` coverage. A fully pinned lockfile (generated by `uv export --format pylock.toml` over the same requests==2.28.0 graph as uv-smoke) parsed via parsePyLockData. Distinct from uv-smoke: pylock.toml builds nested per-artifact file sub-components carrying `evidence.identity` in CycloneDX 1.5 object form, which is why this scenario also guards the normalizer's tolerance of both identity shapes.
